label: preparing
what: A surprise tribute celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, in the great hall at day 1 eighteen hundred, disguised as a lighting inspection. Builder coordinates the timed attendance and lighting; innkeeper arranges bread, freight delivers and seeks supplies, and baker supplies bread and seeks grain. Secretary knowingly helps arrange attendance and funding requests and has privately disclosed the surprise to the mayor. Neighbour relays catering requests, though knowledge of the tribute itself is uncertain.
